The Building Engineer is responsible for the safe and efficient operation, maintenance, and repair of various mechanical, electrical, and plumbing systems within a facility. This role requires compliance with all federal, state, and local regulations, as well as the organization's safety policies. The Technician will ensure that all systems function optimally, contributing to a safe and comfortable environment for all building occupants.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Operate and maintain boilers, compressors, refrigeration equipment, generators, and other systems powered by steam, air, diesel, gas, or water within life science facilities preferred.
  • Conduct facility rounds to monitor and maintain mechanical, HVAC, electrical, piping, and plumbing systems.
  • Repair and replace components such as toilets, sinks, faucets, and dispensers.
  • Maintain and repair flooring, including tile and carpet
